description: This PHP test class, CandidateJobOfferingAPITest, tests the CandidateJobOfferingAPI within the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin. It includes setup routines, and tests for API methods such as getOne, getValidationRuleForGetOne, update, delete, and getValidationRuleForDelete.

classes.name: CandidateJobOfferingAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the CandidateJobOfferingAPI endpoints related to candidate job offerings within the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment before each test, particularly truncating specific database tables.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests the getOne method of the CandidateJobOfferingAPI, expecting a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Tests the validation rules for the getOne API method, expecting a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests the update method of the CandidateJobOfferingAPI with specific test cases.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestUpdate
methods.description: Provides test cases for the testUpdate method, sourcing data from a YAML file.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests the delete method of the CandidateJobOfferingAPI, expecting a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Tests the validation rules for the delete API method, expecting a not implemented exception.
